tax.text: She voted to preserve enforcement against wealthy tax avoidance and said people should pay their fair share.
tax.quote: I voted last year to close these loopholes because I believe every American should pay their fair share – especially the wealthiest one percent.

wages.text: She voted to advance the Raise the Wage Act, which would gradually raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour.
wages.quote: I am proud to have voted with my colleagues to send this bill to the full House, and look forward to supporting its final passage

trade.text: She criticized Trump’s tariffs and trade war as raising prices for working families.
trade.quote: Trump’s ill-conceived trade war is set to unleash the largest tax increase on working families in U.S. history

debt.text: She has opposed proposed cuts to Social Security and Medicare and supported legislation to strengthen Social Security benefits.
debt.quote: I strongly oppose any attempts to cut benefits, and I support the Social Security 2100 Act

housing.text: She secured federal funding for an affordable housing project and described it as expanding the region’s housing supply.
housing.quote: it’s about expanding the supply of housing that hardworking families in Methuen and across Massachusetts desperately need

schools.text: She voted against a bill that included a permanent tax credit for private school vouchers, which she said would drain funding from public schools.
schools.quote: The bill creates a permanent, unlimited tax credit for private school vouchers, draining funds from public schools

safety.text: She voted for a package that funded community policing and officer hiring as well as violence-prevention and mental-health responses.
safety.quote: The legislation will bolster local community policing programs, invest in officer hiring and training programs, provide funding for local violence prevention programs, and create grants for mental health officials

immigration.text: She said she would promote naturalization and work toward a pathway to citizenship, including protections for DACA recipients and DREAMers.
immigration.quote: Lori believes that comprehensive immigration reform starts with creating a fair and equal pathway to citizenship.

guns.text: She has supported universal background checks and voted for legislation to restrict assault weapons and firearm access for domestic abusers.
guns.quote: This bill would mandate background checks for all gun purchases, including those at gun shows

abortion.text: She supports codifying abortion rights and has cosponsored legislation to protect access to abortion care.
abortion.quote: The right to abortion is a fundamental right—one that must be safeguarded in federal law.

gender.text: She voted against a bill barring transgender girls and women from participating in school sports consistent with their gender identity.
gender.quote: Today, Congresswoman Lori Trahan (MA-03) voted against House Republicans’ legislation to implement a trans and intersex sports ban.

health.text: She identifies expanding Medicare as a priority.
health.quote: Congresswoman Trahan is fighting to protect Social Security, expand Medicare, defend protections for people with preexisting conditions

energy.text: She voted to advance legislation supporting clean energy investment and a target of reducing greenhouse gas emissions 50–52% below 2005 levels by 2030.
energy.quote: The Build Back Better framework will set the United States on course to meet its climate targets – a 50-52% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions below 2005 levels by 2030

voting.text: She supported nationwide vote-by-mail during the COVID-19 pandemic and voted for legislation to expand ballot access and voting rights.
voting.quote: Congresswoman Trahan is strongly in favor of nationwide vote-by-mail throughout all elections that occur during the COVID-19 pandemic

housing.text: He opposes regulations he says drive up housing costs and limit supply.
housing.quote: Stop unrealistic regulations that drive up housing costs and limit supply.

safety.text: He supports law enforcement partnerships and community-based mental health and addiction services.
safety.quote: Support law enforcement with community partnerships that build trust and improve public safety outcomes.

guns.text: He says he will protect law-abiding citizens’ right to keep and bear arms.
guns.quote: The Second Amendment shall not be infringed. Gary will protect the constitutional right of every law-abiding citizen to keep and bear arms.

energy.text: He says he will pursue energy solutions that lower household bills.
energy.quote: Gary will push for affordable, evidence-based energy solutions that lower your bills immediately.

housing.text: He said housing costs would fall as the country reduced immigration and built more units.
housing.quote: Housing will come down as we reduce the number of uninvited guests in America and as we build more units.

immigration.text: He said he would ban further immigration from more than 50 Muslim-majority countries.
immigration.quote: The only change I would make is to ensure a ban on any further immigration from the 50 plus Muslim majority countries.

energy.text: He criticized blocked gas pipelines and clean-energy programs, saying they contributed to higher natural gas costs.
energy.quote: As a result of her non-scientific thinking, I am paying too much for natural gas for 2 reasons. First, she blocked 2 gas pipelines.
